output.summary: The user’s endometriosis pain was returning on the combined pill and was worst during the break week; they wanted to understand alternatives. The conversation covered continuous use, progestin options, Mirena, GnRH medicines, and non-hormonal support, alongside the user’s history of disease on the ovary and near the bowel and discharge back to the GP after surgery. The user left with a list of topics to raise with the GP and said they felt less stuck.
